The minimum account equity threshold required to keep an open position active without triggering a margin call.
Daily MTM losses causing account equity to fall below the Maintenance Margin level.
The additional cash deposited by a trader to restore an account back up to the Initial Margin level after receiving a margin call.

front: How does daily Mark-to-Market (MTM) settlement work?
back: Positions are revalued every session against the daily settlement price, with cash profits credited and cash losses debited daily.
A scenario-based system that sets margin by evaluating combined portfolio gains and losses across multiple price and volatility scenarios.

front: Why does Portfolio Margining benefit hedged strategies?
back: It recognizes risk offsets between opposing positions, reducing overall worst-scenario loss and lowering total collateral requirements.
